documents.source_title: EU WEEE Directive & Basel Convention Compliance Framework
documents.author: European Commission / Basel Action Network (BAN)
documents.excerpt: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) containing brominated flame retardants, lead, mercury, or lithium batteries must be routed exclusively to certified R2/e-Stewards recyclers. Component recovery (harvesting RAM, functional SSDs, power supplies) must precede final material reclamation to maximize secondary resource loops.

documents.source_title: Institutional Sustainable Surplus Asset Disposition Policy
documents.author: University Sustainability & Procurement Directorate
documents.excerpt: Institutional hierarchy of disposition mandates: 1) Internal redeployment to meet open departmental hardware requests; 2) In-house repair and thermal rejuvenation; 3) Repurposing for dedicated lab/infrastructure nodes; 4) Modular component harvesting for the institutional repair spare-parts inventory; 5) Certified e-waste recycling. Decommissioning directly to scrap without circular evaluation is prohibited.
